chatbot.title: Global Seed Assistant
chatbot.welcome: Hello! Welcome to Global Seed Company.
chatbot.greeting: How can we help you today?
chatbot.seeds: What types of seeds do you offer?
chatbot.selection: How can I find the right seeds?
chatbot.catalogue: Where can I explore your catalogue?

answers.company: Welcome to Global Seed Company. Explore our website to learn more about the company and its seed-related offerings. For verified company information, our team will be happy to help.
answers.contact: We would be glad to hear from you. Visit our Contact page to share your inquiry with the Global Seed Company team.
answers.catalogue: Our seed catalogue is the place to explore the products currently listed on this website. Select a product to view its available information.
answers.distribution: For distribution opportunities, business proposals or partnership inquiries, please contact our team directly. They can provide information based on current company arrangements.
answers.seeds: You can explore the seed varieties currently listed in our online catalogue. For additional product details or availability, please contact our team.
answers.selection: Choosing seeds depends on factors such as your crop, growing conditions and farming goals. Explore our catalogue and contact our team if you need help finding relevant product information.
